text.formatted: This wand has 3 charges. While holding it, you can expend 1 charge as an action to cast the Detect Magic spell from it. The wand regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn.
text.plain: This wand has 3 charges. While holding it, you can expend 1 charge as an action to cast the Detect Magic spell from it. The wand regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn.
